Fantasy Football Planner
Yerassyl Almakhan & Ualikhan Beibarys · Final 2026
Original midterm concept and pages: Yerassyl Almakhan & Ualikhan Beibarys. Development, writing and original CSS/SVG graphics assisted by OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex. Adding the stadium background photo to the CSS was assisted by Claude (Anthropic). Background photo “Twilight Stadium Ball on Emerald Turf”: supplied by the project author (original source/license not included in the supplied archive; author must verify before submission). Bootstrap 5.3.3 for form components; jQuery 3.6.1 for animations (both MIT licensed). All player prices, points, club associations, fixtures and articles are illustrative learning content, not current football news or official FPL data. No affiliation with the Premier League. Preferences and plans stay in this browser; no email is sent.
